neighbours.label: a magnitude word that sets up the size of an effect or pressure (had little impact, exert strong pressure, carry great weight)
fire: The new tariffs have had little effect on overall imports.
Rapid urban growth puts heavy pressure on local water supplies.
Her testimony carried considerable weight with the jury.
The reforms had a significant impact on rural poverty.
Tourism exerts strong pressure on fragile coral reefs.
His opinion has enormous influence among younger voters.
The scandal had only a minor effect on the party's ratings.
Rising rents place a great burden on young families.
quiet: The new tariffs were announced by the trade minister on Friday.
Rapid urban growth has turned the old village into a busy suburb.
Her testimony lasted three hours and ended late in the evening.
The reforms were written by a small committee of economists.
Tourism brings many visitors to the beaches every summer.
His opinion column appears in the paper every Sunday morning.
The scandal was first reported by a local radio station.
Rising rents are listed in the annual housing report.
